name: Cavite Speedcubing Open 2017

venue.name: [CityMall Anabu](http://citymall.com.ph/anabu%20imus.htm)

information:
**Registration Fee is 300php for the first 3 events (any of your choice)**.

Competitors joining more than 3 events shall pay additional 50php per extra event over the limit of 3 events. Payment should be settled before WCA registration is approved. For further queries, kindly message the facebookpage of the Philippine Cubers Association.
